versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323 If a Category 2 ISR calls DisableAllInterrupts / SuspendAllInterrupts / SuspendOSInterrupts and ends (returns) without calling the corresponding En- ableAllInterrupts / ResumeAllInterrupts / ResumeOSInterrupts , the Op- erating System module shall perform the missing service and shall call the ErrorHook (if configured) with the status E_OS_DISABLEDINT .

If a Category 2 ISR calls DisableAllInterrupts / Sus- pendAllInterrupts / SuspendOSInterrupts and ends (returns) without call- ing the corresponding EnableAllInterrupts / ResumeAllInterrupts / Re- sumeOSInterrupts , the Operating System module shall perform the missing service and shall call the ErrorHook (if configured) with the status E_OS_DISABLEDINT .
